The Spirit Talker works in a similar way to the world famous Ovilus device.

Please check the compatibility of your phone / tablet.

The sensors that the app uses are:

Magnetometer (EMF)
Accelerometer
Gyroscope
Orientation
Barometer
Compass

This app works by reading the values from the sensors in your device, these values are constantly changing depending on the environment, so sometimes the app may produce what seem like random words.

Languages in the app are:

English, Latin, French, German, Chinese (Text or Symbols), Danish, Portuguese, Romanian, Turkish, Croatian, Polish, Finnish, Swedish, Hungarian, Greek, Czech, Dutch, Italian, Spanish and Icelandic.
